Description.content: My name is Huong. I don’t like pizza but I like sandwiches. My favourite sport is football.

My house is where my family lives. It is blue. There are four bedrooms. We have a kitchen and three bathrooms. Our family room is where we like to watch television together. When people come over, we eat in the dining room.We have a playroom in the basement. We have a swing in the backyard. I love my house.

My name is Nam. I'm ten years old. I live in Ha Noi. I enjoy maths, music and art. My favorite food is chips. I don't like pork. In the afternoon, I usually play chess with my father. It's really fun.

Hi, I'm Kathy and I live in Chicago. I live in a house near the library. My school is next to my house. I walk to school every day. I'm in 5th grade. My brother, Kevin is in 9th grade and his school is in the city centre, next to the library.
My name is Mark. I'm in class 5A. I live in the countryside. I really enjoy playing table tennis every day.
My name is Linda. I live in a big city with my parents. I love drawing and playing the piano.

Description.content: My name is Cynthia and I live in Manta. There are three elementary schools and two high schools in Manta. My school is on Montecristi Street. We have a very nice building. There is a sports center next to my school. Every Wednesday afternoon, we play basketball. If you want to see a film, you can go to the only cinema we have. Unfortunately, there aren't any theaters here. I like living in Manta because it is a calm, neat place, and people are very friendly.

content.content: There aren't any cinemas in Manta.

Description.content: I'm Linh. I'm ten years old. I live in Ho Chi Minh City. I like geography, music and English. My favourite food is chicken. I don't like beef. In the evening, I usually play the piano with my sister. It's really fun.
I live in Australia. I have one brother and three sisters. I like maths and PE more than English.
